name: aquila-agents
description: One window for all your Claude Code / Codex sessions across projects.

scripts.dev: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && concurrently -k -n vite,tsc,app -c blue,yellow,magenta "vite" "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json -w --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on tcp:5199 && cross-env AQUILA_DEV=1 electron ."
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.smoke: npm run build && cross-env AQUILA_SMOKE=1 electron .
scripts.perf: npm run build && cross-env AQUILA_SMOKE=1 AQUILA_PERF=1 electron .
scripts.dist: node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON scripts/release-notes.ts check && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON scripts/release-notes.ts check && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --arm64 --publish never
